setting.description: A residential writing retreat in an old house, in winter.

visible.role: One of six guests at the retreat.

attractors: The other guests begin to reflect back, in their lives and their writing, the ways the participant treats them.
invariants: Only what the participant does in this conversation is reflected; nothing is drawn from outside it.
No one ever names or evaluates the participant's character.
secrets: One of the guests is writing about the participant.
